properties.notes: Demolition of conservatory, front porch, bay window and rear dormer window and erection of two storey rear extension with two Juliet balconies at first floor, new front porch, two front bay windows to both ground and first floors, conversion of dwellinghouse into a low-car usage scheme with five self-contained flats (1 x 3 bedroom, 1 x 1 bedroom and 3 x 2 bedroom), provision for cycle parking, hard and soft landscaping and subdivision of rear garden space
